entry.name: array.shift
entry.digest: Remove an element from the beginning of an array
entry.description: Set the array to shift, then send bangs repeatedly to output the elements of the array one at a time. The remainder of the array is sent out the right outlet, and a bang is sent out the leftmost outlet when the array is empty.
